runs.question: What's our refund rate this month?
runs.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS start_at, (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + INTERVAL '1 MONTH') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS end_at), totals AS (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds AS r, bounds AS b WHERE r.created_at >= b.start_at AND r.created_at < b.end_at) AS refund_cents, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents), 0) FROM orders AS o, bounds AS b WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.placed_at >= b.start_at AND o.placed_at < b.end_at) AS revenue_cents) SELECT refund_cents * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_cents, 0) AS refund_rate_pct FROM totals LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Our refund rate this month is 7.559950877965599%, interpreting it as refund dollars issued divided by gross revenue from paid, shipped, or delivered transactions (orders) placed this month, as of 5:22 PM EST.

runs.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT SUM(orders.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-10-26T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-02T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)), m_refund AS (SELECT SUM(refunds.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds WHERE refunds.created_at >= CAST('2026-10-26T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND refunds.created_at < CAST('2026-11-02T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT (COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01) - (COALESCE(refunded_cents, 0) * 0.01) AS net_revenue FROM m_order CROSS JOIN m_refund LIMIT 1000

runs.question: What was our average order value last month?
runs.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT SUM(orders.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS gross_revenue_cents, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS revenue_orders FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT (CAST(COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS DECIMAL)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(revenue_orders, 0), 0) AS aov FROM m_order LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Average order value last month was $120.30, defined as gross revenue divided by the number of paid, shipped or delivered orders, as of 5:23 PM EST.
